inlines.v: BIB, noun A small piece of linen or other cloth worn by children over the breast. 1. A fish about a foot in length, the back of a light olive, the sides yellow, and the belly white. BIB, verb transitive [Latin bibo.] To sip; to tipple; to drink frequently. [Little used.]
